description: This file defines the interface SchedulerJobRunnerReadService in a Java project, specifying methods for retrieving job details and histories within a scheduling system in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: SchedulerJobRunnerReadService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to read scheduler job details and history, including retrieving specific jobs and checking if updates are allowed.

methods.name: findAllJobDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all job details.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific job detail by specified ID type and identifier.

methods.name: retrieveJobHistory
methods.description: Retrieves paginated job history data for a specified job identified by ID type and identifier.

methods.name: retrieveId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID (Long) for a given job specified by ID type and identifier.

methods.name: isUpdatesAllowed
methods.description: Indicates whether updates are permitted in this context.
